title: Faculty of Nursing | KPGU
content: of Nursing - KPGU, Vadodara WELCOME Message from the Director Prof. Nimesh Chokshi Director, KSN Krishna School of Nursing (KSN) is a constituent institute of KPGU, Vadodara - dedicated to producing skilled, compassionate nursing professionals who meet the standards of the Indian Nursing Council (INC). Our programs are designed to develop nurses who are not just clinically competent but genuinely prepared to lead and serve in modern healthcare environments.
